previous_attempts: Not enough verified facts to build a 3-tier pick set. Research found only: Seiko SPB383 at US$1,500 (Seiko US site); Tudor Black Bay GMT M79830RB-0001 at $5,275 MSRP on Tudor's site (US market not confirmed); Oris Big Crown Pointer Date at $2,400 (not a GMT, so it does not fit the GMT tier). No Oris

Attempt 3 stopped before building. Verified so far: Seiko SPB383 at US$1,500 (Seiko US site, 2026 price not re-dated). Tudor Black Bay GMT 41mm is about $4,925 (fabric) to $5,275 (bracelet) per dealer listings as of Aug-Sep 2026, with sources disagreeing, so it does not clear a firm under-$5,000 cap
stop_reason: Attempt 4 stopped before building. The GMT tier has no verified candidate with a firm dated US price under the cap. Seiko SPB383 is consistent at US$1,500 across dealers (WatchCharts, Exquisite Timepieces, Teddy Baldassarre), but Seiko's own US page did not show its price, and it is a single-spec dive GMT. Tudor Black Bay GMT 79830RB: Tudor's site lists $5,275 MSRP while The1916 Company lists $4,925, so the price sources disagree and the candidate is dropped under the lesson rule. Oris and Hamilton GMT candidates were not verified. Per the lesson, the whole format needs replacing with one where every slot has a confirmed source, which needs a new idea from the owner or a fresh run.
